Now let's make the numbers! I say a number, and you build it with the beads.
Only your right hand moves the beads. Keep it ready — never resting on the frame.
Watch. My thumb pushes one bottom bead up to the bar.
Now you. Push one bead up to make 1.
Each time, add one more bead. No rushing — slow and sure.
Make 2. Push up one more bead.
You used all four bottom beads. For 5, there are no more — so we use the special top bead.
First, your left finger presses the button to clear them.
Now your index finger brings the top bead down. That's 5!
Your turn. Bring the top bead down to make 5.
You can make the numbers now! Practise a little every day and you'll get even faster.
